analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($116.80) vs SMA5 ($115.55)/SMA20 ($131.46)/SMA50 ($142.94): Short-term trend above SMA5 but mid-to-long-term trends are below, indicating weakness.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($144.78)/SMA200 ($134.39): Confirmation of weakening medium-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (40.6%): High relative to historical lows but low relative to highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.4 → 37.6): Slightly recovering after entering oversold territory but still maintaining a weak level.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2430 → -1.6628): Worsening within negative territory, signaling strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $108.75): Approaching the lower band, requiring support confirmation on further declines.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($114.63): Expected to act as a key support level on declines, along with the 20-day low pattern.
· Swing resistance ($118.97): Potential to act as the first resistance zone on short-term rallies.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low): 5-day low is lower than the 20-day low, suggesting a potential continuation of the bearish trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.80): Below average volume, indicating low confidence in current price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): With RSI entering oversold and MACD continuing to worsen, a wait-and-see approach is advised while monitoring for potential downtrend continuation.
